title: The Punishment of Being Made to Eat It
text: “It seems things resolved themselves rather easily, but…”
“MALTYYYYYYY!”
Trash was letting out a scream. Back then he’d seemed hollow, empty, but this time—perhaps because Tiger Girl was present—the color of his grief seemed far more intense.
“Impossible! This must not be! Malty, why would you—! Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhhhh!?”
“What on earth happened… Melty-chan? Do you know?”
“Umm… well…”
Fiancée looked troubled too as she tried to answer Father’s question.

“Before the party preparations began, Father invited Mother to tea just to talk a little, and Atla-chan and the rest of us ended up joining in. Apparently Father thought Big Sister might be reflecting on herself, so it doubled as an introduction.”

Well, if nothing had been done about it, the Crimson Swine—having just been handed down a punishment—was clearly gearing up to slip poison to Father, someone she despised, right around the party’s mealtime, I say. According to Fiancée, Trash had apparently intended to introduce the Crimson Swine to Tiger Girl.
“Ah… Malty… so it was a lie, saying you wanted to get along with that girl…”
Trash muttered this quietly.
“…So it really was that girl who suggested it to you. I suspected as much… And because even you harbored some doubt, you had her drink it as a precaution, and it ended up like this…”

It seemed the Crimson Swine had asked Trash if she could have tea with Tiger Girl. Even I’d had a bad feeling from the moment I saw the Crimson Swine’s reaction upon meeting Tiger Girl, but I hadn’t expected her to pull something so foolish this quickly… Still, it was shocking that the bottle the Crimson Swine had been secretly hoarding really did turn out to be that Ouroboros Deadly Poison. And so, in just such a fashion, Trash had arranged a small tea gathering with the Queen also in attendance, held in a room with the Crimson Swine, Rafumi disguised as Ren, Fiancée, and the tiger siblings all present. Since Ren was already officially engaged to Fiancée, he’d been made to attend as well.
“Big Sister was seeking sympathy from Father, and even more so from Mother, all while putting on this air of being terribly understanding. I did think something seemed off about it, but…”
“Mm… and then?”

“Big Sister ordered the castle servants to bring snacks and tea to the room’s entrance, insisting that from here on, it was to be handled between blood relatives, and so she herself brought in the tea and sweets…”
Suspicious beyond belief, I say. Fancy letting the Crimson Swine handle the serving and all that.
“Of course, Atla had no intention whatsoever of touching any of it, and while feeling uneasy about the whole thing…”
“Tiger Girl could tell something monstrous had been slipped into it.”
“I hadn’t noticed…”
“It was something so cunningly concealed that even Brother couldn’t detect it. Whatever could it have been…? Of course, Tiger Girl intended to give warning.”

So it seemed Tiger Girl had sensed it and had absolutely no intention of touching anything. Apparently the Crimson Swine had placed a plate of tea and sweets before each person. And there, seeing the Crimson Swine putting on this show of reflecting and eagerly serving everyone, Trash pointed at the plate given to Tiger Girl and issued a command.
“Malty, so you’ve truly had a change of heart, have you. But your mother remains suspicious. So you eat this tea and everything on this plate.”

The Queen furrowed her brow at Trash for calling her by her old name despite the renaming, seemingly about to scold him for it, but upon seeing his demeanor, she apparently let it go, at least for the moment.
“Buhi-buh-bu-bu!”
The Crimson Swine seemed to be making excuses.
“Yes, yes, I believe you. So eat. Prove your innocence to us, just like this.”
Apparently, had Trash not said it, the Queen had been about to command the very same thing.
“Buhiiiiiii!”
And so, seizing the moment, the Crimson Swine reportedly screeched and thrashed, absolutely refusing to eat. Ha! Caught red-handed, I say.
“Haah… honestly, the words hadn’t even left her lips before she tried something like this…”
“Wife! I beg you, let this child off with only a bit of suffering from what she herself prepared!”

Trash apparently proposed this to the Queen in an attempt to stop the Crimson Swine’s shipment out. Trash, wanting so badly to believe in her, had gone along with it up until the very end—only to betray her at the last moment. And yet… would the Trash of worlds past ever have handed down a punishment that involved making someone eat the poison themselves? Somehow, I doubted it.
“Buhyaaa! Buhya-buhya!”
“Big Sister, before you hurl abuse at Father, perhaps you should feel shame for your own actions. Father wanted so badly to believe in you.”
“Hmph, quite fitting, I’d say. Serves her right—dig one hole for another, and you’ll fall into it yourself.”
What on earth was Rafumi even saying there? Don’t just pile on, I say.
“…Very well.”
The Queen too sighed and clapped her hands, summoning soldiers to restrain the Crimson Swine.
“And prepare an antidote as well!”
Trash apparently gave that order too, offering what little cover he could manage.
“Bu… bu… bububbubububu—buhyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaAAAAAAAAAAAA!?!?!?”
The Crimson Swine threw off the soldiers’ restraints and began writhing and thrashing, clawing at her own throat.
“Malty… why would you poison this child… when I love you so, even without you doing such a thing…”
“Foolish creature… so she truly meant to poison her after all…!?”
Around this point, things apparently started taking a grim turn. Both Trash and the Queen, having witnessed such incidents before, immediately recognized the true nature of the poison.
“Th-that’s impossible!?”
“This is—! Emergency Call! We need to get away from this spot immediately—Just Away!—or the damage will spread—Infection Expansion—and become a Miasma Field of contamination!”
“AAAAaaaaah——”
And so… the Crimson Swine, displaying the symptoms of Ouroboros Deadly Poison, breathed her last.
“Th-this is—! Quick, we need resuscitation—”
“No one is to touch her! Everyone! Evacuate this area immediately!”
The Queen made the call instantly, and the moment everyone hurried to distance themselves, the now-deceased Crimson Swine apparently began transforming into an Apostle of Ouroboros.
“M-Malty! MALTYYYYYYYYYYYYY!”
And so Trash’s scream echoed once more.
“As for the rest, it went exactly as everyone who rushed to the scene must have judged… but…”

“So basically… even after already being punished, she brazenly tried to kill Atla-chan and the others right there using some horrifying poison? She’d obviously be the prime suspect, so her head must be completely fried… or did she have some scheme to pin the blame on someone else and slip away?”
Father muttered this almost involuntarily.
“Perhaps precisely because she was already under suspicion, she was counting on that very fact to work in her favor somehow. Even so, it was a foolish move.”
And then, for some reason, everyone’s eyes turned toward me.
“It wasn’t me, I say!? Why is everyone looking at me!?”
“Because you’ve already caused plenty of trouble on your own.”
Itsuki, always so annoying.
“Well… Motoyasu-kun was there with them, after all… I guess given the scale of what happened, eyes just naturally wandered your way.”
Most unjust, I say. This time, it truly wasn’t me.
“Anyway, back to the matter at hand…”
“I imagine she meant to pin it on the servants or the chef who brought the food?”
“That possibility is extremely high.”
“N-no! It was them! Those servants are the culprits!”
Trash, looking as though he’d cling to any straw available, tried pushing the servants-did-it theory.
“It’s not entirely implausible, but…”
“Trash, Mal—Bitch’s resistance alone makes that possibility extremely unlikely, and you yourself surely know that, don’t you? You were trying to handle this yourself as her just deserts.”
“Ngh…”

The servants-as-culprits theory fell apart at its very foundation—Trash himself, unable to trust the Crimson Swine, had forced her to drink the very poison she’d prepared. So the whole narrative was fundamentally broken from the start. And really, hadn’t things already turned decisively black the moment suspicion arose over the food being brought to Tiger Girl in the first place? Trash seemed to be racking his brain trying to raise an objection, but eventually his shoulders slumped in defeat.
“Forgive me. I lost my composure.”
And so he apologized to the servants. Given the gravity of the situation, the servants themselves seemed more bewildered than anything else. Hmm, indeed—Trash truly wasn’t the same as before.
“If only I had given warning sooner…”
Tiger Girl murmured this lamentingly, and Trash shook his head.
“No, even if you had tried to warn us, I would have simply pressed on, believing it to be her punishment for that child… Don’t trouble yourself over it.”

With a face that looked even more aged than before, Trash offered comfort to the tiger siblings in a sorrowful tone. And yet, I could sense something like dignity in him now, different from how he’d been in the previous world. After all, he’d gone so far as to actually scold the Crimson Swine. Surely, that meant he’d found at least some measure of resolve.
